proposals.name: Where the Eye Lands
proposals.why: A gallery is judged by where the eye goes first, and this name asks every guardian to send the gaze to the painting before anything else.

proposals.name: Courtyard Light
proposals.why: Elene Akhvlediani's Tbilisi courtyards keep one warm lamp over a wall of pictures, so the light serves the painting and asks nothing for itself.

proposals.name: Quiet Walls
proposals.why: A good gallery is remembered for its quiet walls rather than their decoration, and this panel should be the frame that steps back so the picture can speak.
